a pinch of salt or grated nutmeg on a Flip or Eggnog; a counted line without a known volume fills the slot and adds no ratio; added so that the seed Eggnog (salt) has a slot. Band chosen here, not from a source.

source.note: Assumption, unverified for the bands and the usual ranges; the schema has one evidence field per template, so slotEvidence and usual.evidence stay assumption although the nominal ratio was read. Read: classic 2 oz spirit or fortified wine, 2 tsp demerara sugar, 1 whole egg; root recipe 2 oz oloroso sherry, 1/2 oz syrup, 1 whole egg. The nominal spec (60 ml : 15 ml : 45 ml egg) is the root recipe. The book files Pina Colada and Eggnog under this template; the optional slots are chosen here. See docs/templates.md#evidence.
